items.title: Belief in Allah
items.subtitle: Tawhid
items.body: To believe in Allah as the One true God—His existence, names, attributes, and right to be worshipped alone without partners.

items.title: Belief in Angels
items.subtitle: Mala'ikah
items.body: Angels are noble creations of light who worship Allah and carry out His commands, including recording deeds and delivering revelation.

items.title: Belief in Books
items.subtitle: Kutub
items.body: Allah revealed scriptures to guide humanity. Muslims believe in all books sent by Allah, with the Quran as the final preserved revelation.

items.title: Belief in Messengers
items.subtitle: Rusul
items.body: Allah sent prophets and messengers to every nation to call people to worship Him alone. Muhammad ﷺ is the seal of the prophets.

items.title: Belief in the Last Day
items.subtitle: Yawm al-Akhirah
items.body: Life after death includes resurrection, accountability, Paradise, and Hell. This belief shapes how Muslims live with purpose and responsibility.

items.title: Belief in Divine Decree
items.subtitle: Al-Qadar
items.body: Allah's knowledge and decree encompass all things—good and difficult. Believers strive, trust Allah, and accept outcomes with patience and gratitude.
